description: Measures GPU shared-memory (LDS/SMEM) dependent-access LATENCY: a single-accumulator read->add->write recurrence, so accesses cannot overlap and the kernel time reflects per-access round-trip latency, not bandwidth. (Formerly named shared_mem_bandwidth; renamed because that is what it actually measures. See shared_mem_bandwidth for the throughput test.) Two access patterns: no_conflict (stride-1) and conflict (32-way bank conflict).

scaling_param.name: inner_iters
scaling_param.description: Number of inner-loop iterations per kernel launch; controls total shared memory traffic

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of thread blocks in the grid

non_scaling_params.name: access_pattern
non_scaling_params.description: Shared memory access pattern: no_conflict (stride-1) or conflict (same bank)
